decision.buyer: Motor and actuator suppliers (a hypothesis in #344; a magnetic component, not a qualified robotic joint).
decision.engineering_decision: Choose a permanent-magnet cross-section that maximizes useful torque under a prospectively specified ripple constraint, at fixed outer size, current and magnet use.
decision.intended_use: A small feasibility assessment (#341): whether a bounded magnetic-design candidate exists that Carbon could evaluate, and what its reference would cost.

design_variables.description: Parameters of one permanent-magnet topology's 2D cross-section; the parameter list is not yet fixed.
design_variables.name: cross_section_geometry

next_experiment: Choose one published reproducible motor benchmark and prove a bounded rotor-angle sweep (#344 first task); this is a feasibility assessment, not a dataset.

outputs.description: Torque ripple; its resolution must be demonstrated (#344).
outputs.name: torque_ripple

outputs.description: Selected flux quantities, not yet chosen.
outputs.name: flux_quantities

population.proposed: One permanent-magnet topology with a parameterized 2D cross-section and a stated axial length (#344). A proposed development design, not a ratified production population.

reference.applicability: Candidate: FEMM or a Linux-capable FEM alternative, to be assessed; host automation and licensing must be verified, not assumed (#344). Nothing is pinned or run.

unresolved: Material curves, axial length and the exclusions (end effects, thermal duty, stress, acoustics, drive control) are not yet specified.
Solver choice, Linux automation and licence are unverified.
